action.public_message: I need cash, so I'm selling some houses.
action.private_thought: I need $310 to pay rent to Gamma. I have $50 cash, shortfall $260. Selling houses yields $50 each. Selling 6 houses gives $300, enough. I'll sell 2 houses from each orange property, preserving at least one house on each for future rent. This maximizes cash while retaining some monopoly strength.
